stationId.description: Must match the station that currently owns the active claim on the Pack task. Must be non-empty: the API treats "" as a missing field and rejects it with 400.

contents.description: SKUs scanned for this package. An empty or omitted array is accepted by request validation (it's well-formed JSON) but rejected by the domain with a 422, since sealing requires at least one scanned item.

items.description: A null item is accepted and treated as an empty SKU string (Go's JSON decoding cannot distinguish them).

shipInOwnContainer.description: Opt-in (ADR-0056). `true` asks to ship the order line in its own CASE: it requires `lineQuantity` and exactly one SKU in `contents`, and is refused with a `422` `ship-in-own-container-*` problem unless `lineQuantity` equals the `unitsPerPack` of the SKU's active CASE level. Absent or `false` is the ordinary carton seal, unchanged.

lineQuantity.description: The order line's quantity in EACHES (never cases). Required when `shipInOwnContainer` is `true` (a missing value is a `400`); ignored otherwise.

ordinary.summary: An ordinary carton (the existing request, unchanged)

shipInOwnContainer.summary: An order line that is exactly one full case of 12 eaches
